search: Implement optional search query parameter for GET /api/v1/items/. Filter title or description by case-insensitive substring after trim. Empty search means unfiltered. Enforce normal-user ownership, admins see all; count must be filtered before pagination. Preserve existing schema, no unrelated edits.
paging: Fix GET /api/v1/items/ and GET /api/v1/users/ pagination: reject skip<0, limit<1 or limit>100 with FastAPI HTTP 422. Keep valid behavior. For equal created_at sort items by id DESC as deterministic tie break. Preserve owner permissions and responses.
access: Refactor item GET, PUT and DELETE by id to use a shared private helper that fetches item and checks authorization. Missing -> 404, nonowner -> 403, superuser can access. No behavior change; remove duplicated validation. Keep scope minimal.
summary: Add GET /api/v1/items/summary: return a named ItemSummary model with total, with_description, without_description counts. Description present iff non-null and nonblank after strip. Normal users own items, admin all. Route must precede /{id}; OpenAPI response schema. Prefer SQL aggregation.
rename_user: Refactor the public Python CRUD helper app.crud.get_user_by_email to find_user_by_email. Update every actual Python caller and test import/reference in backend/app and backend/tests, including internal calls in crud.py. Preserve authentication, signup, and duplicate-email checks. Do not leave compatibility alias, change unrelated identifiers, generated TypeScript files or dependencies. Use semantic rename when available, not blind text replacement.
rename_password: Refactor Python security helper get_password_hash to hash_password in backend/app/core/security.py and update every import and call site throughout backend/app and backend/tests. Leave verify_password and other security functions unchanged. Preserve existing hash verification behavior. No compatibility aliases, unrelated edits, or generated clients. Use semantic rename when available.
